answer: Bind each identity to one hashed household utility account, verified by the provider, with only the hash stored. A sybil farm then faces a marble-hard wall: every fake needs a separate real metered home, not a script in a meadow of cheap accounts, and a duplicate hash is rejected on the spot. Think of each home as a knoll in a landscape: one account per hill, no stacking fakes on the same rise. Attacker cost is renting or opening real utility accounts one by one. Limit: it excludes people whose utilities are not in their own name, and providers differ by region.
